pi.name: Smartest
pi._note: Main premium route. On moat-llm-router, LiteLLM routes Smartest to Codex-LB gpt-5.6-sol. Codex-LB catalog reports 372000 input context for gpt-5.6-sol; Tower uses a 95% effective window (372000*0.95=353400) so compaction/output clamps leave headroom. GPT-5.5 remains available temporarily as litellm-responses/gpt55 for rollback/comparison.

pi.name: Smartest Long Context
pi._note: Manual per-session long-context route. On moat-llm-router, LiteLLM routes smartest-long to Codex-LB gpt-5.6-sol. Codex-LB should advertise an explicit operator override of 800000 input context for gpt-5.6-sol; Tower uses a 95% effective window (800000*0.95=760000) so compaction/output clamps leave headroom.

pi.name: Smart
pi._note: Second GPT-5.6 route. On moat-llm-router, LiteLLM routes Smart to Codex-LB gpt-5.6-terra for a balanced/lower-cost alternative to Smartest Sol. Uses the same 95% effective context guard (372000*0.95=353400).

pi.name: GPT-5.5 Legacy
pi._note: Temporary compatibility/rollback route. On moat-llm-router, LiteLLM routes gpt55 to Codex-LB gpt-5.5. Codex-LB registry reports 272000 input for gpt-5.5; Tower uses 272000*0.95=258400 effective window.

pi.name: Mini
pi._note: Fast GPT utility alias. On moat-llm-router, LiteLLM routes mini to Codex-LB gpt-5.6-luna. Tower uses the Codex effective input window (272000*0.95=258400) and the Responses API path (litellm-responses/mini) for title generation, summaries, @ai quick replies, and background utility work where Smartest is overkill.

pi.name: OpenRouter Kimi K2.6 Emergency
pi._note: Manual full-VM emergency route directly from Tower to OpenRouter, bypassing LiteLLM and Codex-LB. This restores the previously verified Kimi K2.6 direct path as an enabled emergency-only model. It is intentionally not the default or an automatic fallback.

pi.name: OpenRouter Kimi K3 Emergency
pi._note: Manual full-VM emergency route directly from Tower to OpenRouter, bypassing LiteLLM and Codex-LB. Kimi K3 has a very large context window and higher output cost, so it is intentionally manual-only and not a default or automatic fallback.

pi.name: Azure GPT-5.5 Emergency
pi._note: Manual full-VM emergency route only. Azure GPT-5.5 may remain available for operator debugging, but it is not the default and should not be used as automatic customer fallback. Current session default is litellm-responses/smartest. 근거: workspace/decisions/2026-05-17-azure-multi-region-provider-namespace.md
